correctness.rationale: For independent image choices with diagonal probability q and uniform off-diagonal probability r=(1-q)/(n-1), conditioning on the exact loop set S leaves n-f independent nonself choices. A specified subset R of s non-loop vertices is origin-free of incoming edges with probability ((n-s)/(n-1))^s ((n-s-1)/(n-1))^(n-f-s). Multiplying by (n-f)_s and mixing F~Bin(n,q) establishes the entire joint factorial-generating polynomial, including n=2 and q=0,1 via polynomial extension. A direct ordered-pair expectation gives Cov(F,L)=n q(1-q)(1-r)^(n-2)(1-nq)/(n-1), so the interior sign flips at q=1/n. For n>=3 the conditional mean g(n-f) with g(k)=k((n-2)/(n-1))^(k-1) rises f=0->1, ties f=1,2, and then falls. Checked independent exact rational enumeration for all n^n maps with n=2,3,4 against the factorial coefficient and covariance, including q=0 and q=1. Finite checks corroborate, not prove, the all-n counting proof.
